description: Repeated motifs of nested squares inspired by Vera Molnár. Each instance contains count layers; instances duplicates the entire motif. Layouts fit copies to the canvas automatically. A two-color palette, an opaque background, fill or outline drawing, opacity and rounded corners change the same square system. Defaults are four black-and-white motifs in a 2-column grid. Only the count slider is visible; the Agent controls all configuration settings.
systemPrompt: Interpret requests in any language. Return every declared parameter, preserving all unrelated current values. Never reset other settings to defaults. count means nested squares PER instance; instances means copies of the WHOLE motif. When changing instances in a grid without a specified column count, use ceil(sqrt(instances)) columns. Use layout grid, row, column or ring for the requested arrangement. spacing changes separation; scale changes motif size; offsets move the whole composition, with negative Y upward. Convert angles in degrees to radians. globalRotation sets the base composition angle; spin rotates the whole composition in radians/second. A request to freeze all motion sets speed=0 and spin=0. phaseStep=0 synchronizes copies; larger phaseStep offsets their organic motion. Faster/slower changes speed relatively, normally double/half; more/fewer squares means count plus/minus 5 if unspecified. Set filled=false for outlines and use strokeWidth for line thickness. Use identical colorA and colorB for a single-color result. Set fillMode=gradient only when blending through the palette is requested; otherwise preserve the current mode. Color values MUST be six-digit #RRGGBB strings; translate named colors to hex. opacity is 0–1, so 40 percent means 0.4; roundness is 0–0.5, so 20 percent means 0.2. Keep minSize <= maxSize and keep all values within the schema bounds. Do not generate code or new parameters. Return JSON only.

count.description: Nested squares in EACH motif, 1–50. This is the visible slider; use instances to duplicate entire motifs.

minSize.description: Smallest square side length in logical canvas pixels. Must not exceed maxSize.

maxSize.description: Largest square side length in logical canvas pixels. Must not be smaller than minSize.

amplitude.description: Maximum positional drift in logical canvas pixels. Zero centers every square; larger values spread their movement farther.

noiseStep.description: Distance between neighboring Perlin noise samples. Smaller values make motion more coordinated; larger values make neighboring squares move more independently. Zero shares the same noise samples.

rotation.description: Maximum tilt in radians. Zero keeps squares upright; PI/4 is 45 degrees. The system varies tilt between negative and positive values.

deformation.description: Relative variation of each side length. Zero keeps squares square; 0.08 means up to 8 percent variation, and 0.5 up to 50 percent.

speed.description: Perlin noise time step at 60 fps. Larger values animate faster. Zero freezes motion; the initial speed is 0.006.

instances.description: Number of copies of the whole nested-square motif, independent of count.

layout.description: Arrange copies in a grid, horizontal row, vertical column, or circular ring.

columns.description: Grid columns; used only with layout=grid.

spacing.description: Distance between copy centers. 1 uses the fitted layout; 0 overlaps all copies.

scale.description: Motif size multiplier after automatic layout fitting. Does not change spacing.

offsetX.description: Whole-composition horizontal offset relative to half the canvas width; negative moves left.

offsetY.description: Whole-composition vertical offset relative to half the canvas height; negative moves up.

globalRotation.description: Base rotation of the whole layout in radians, independent of organic layer tilt.

spin.description: Continuous whole-layout rotation speed in radians/second; negative reverses direction.

phaseStep.description: Organic-motion time offset between copies. Zero synchronizes them.

filled.description: true draws solid nested color bands; false draws only outlines.

fillMode.description: Alternate colorA/colorB across layers or interpolate from outer colorA to inner colorB.

strokeWidth.description: Outline width in logical pixels before motif scaling; used when filled=false.

roundness.description: Corner radius relative to the shortest side. Zero keeps sharp square corners.

opacity.description: Shape opacity, including outlines: 1 is opaque, 0 is invisible.

colorA.description: First band or outer gradient color as #RRGGBB.

colorB.description: Second band or inner gradient color as #RRGGBB. Match colorA for a single color.

examples: Arrange nine square motifs in a 3 by 3 grid.
Place eight motifs in a ring with cyan outlines.
Use blue and yellow squares on a white background.
Round the corners to 20 percent and set opacity to 40 percent.
